schedule_rule: Sequential admission after measured previous cost;stop on first external runtime/model/resource error. Remaining runs are NOT_RUN,not retries. Same-seed replay is not independent evaluation.
observed_universe: Freeze baseline observable order before any do results;do constants alone are not failure.
api: Use six returns and direct intervention_dict,never apply_interventions or four-unpack CLI.
instrumentation: Pass-through runtime observers may record graph/equation/file/seed/data alignment without changing upstream bytes or return values.
scientific_gates: active level1 equations vs level2 conditional causal semantics/all row-producing paths
same fixed observed mask and typed latent projection
hard force replacement/removal of incoming parents/downstream recomputation
replay and actual effective seed dependence
ADMG query identifiability and observation support,not numerical do alone
failure: Infrastructure/rights/resources do not imply scientific rejection. Model/reference mismatch or impossible original contract can reject;unknowns never count PASS.
